brand_system.imagery_direction: macro product details, craftsmanship, architecture, human service moments
brand_system.logo_direction: quiet wordmark for Vale & Vellum; refined spacing, no loud badge
brand_system.motion_style: slow, restrained reveals; no bouncy UI

allowed_modes.intent: Create a premium, art-directed experience with restraint, asymmetry, tactile imagery, and slow confidence.
allowed_modes.name: Editorial Luxury
allowed_modes.when_to_use: Luxury, fashion, portfolio, creative, hospitality, architecture, and visual brands.

allowed_modes.intent: Use scroll progression, layered sections, pinned moments, and reveal timing to tell a product or brand story.
allowed_modes.name: Cinematic Scroll
allowed_modes.when_to_use: Launch pages, campaigns, construction/project stories, high-end product stories, AI product demos, and immersive marketing pages.

allowed_modes.intent: Use depth, foreground/background motion, and anchored content to create visual drama without requiring full 3D.
allowed_modes.name: Parallax Story
allowed_modes.when_to_use: Travel, real estate, construction, fashion, portfolio, NGO field stories, and visual company sites.

allowed_modes.intent: Ship a refined, fast, content-led interface where hierarchy, copy, imagery, and spacing carry the experience.
allowed_modes.name: Static Polished
allowed_modes.when_to_use: Default for serious business, public-service, finance, healthcare, and documentation pages where speed and clarity matter more than spectacle.

experience_mode.fallback_requirement: Fallback is normal responsive semantic content.
experience_mode.intent: Create a premium, art-directed experience with restraint, asymmetry, tactile imagery, and slow confidence.
motion_rules: Motion should feel slow, intentional, and expensive, not busy.
Never bury text inside cards when the hero should be media-led.
Use imagery, texture, and type rhythm as the main signal.
Pick interaction libraries from the mode; do not add heavy animation libraries unless the mode benefits from them.
Every motion/3D/parallax effect must have a user-facing purpose and a reduced-motion or fallback path.
Friday implementation must verify screenshots, responsiveness, interaction smoke, and performance before claiming visual quality.

performance_budget.rule: prioritize Core Web Vitals, readable layout, and fast interaction feedback

rejection_rules: Reject if it looks like generic SaaS, ecommerce template clutter, or loud discount marketing.
experience_mode.when_to_use: Luxury, fashion, portfolio, creative, hospitality, architecture, and visual brands.
